text:
Sofia: Quick sync — need to lock the 'final slice' scope for next week's cut. TL;DR: SLA tiers, docs checklist, oncall handoff, pricing knob, monitoring metrics. Who can own each?

Ben: I can take SLAs + monitoring. Initial proposal: Hosted API SLOs — p95 latency <250ms, availability 99.5%; Dedicated capacity — availability 99.9%. Also want an explicit fallback runbook to a smaller model variant when capacity spikes.

Maya: I'll own docs & migration guide. Req: concrete code samples for streaming + error handling, snippet for retry/backoff, and a short 'known limitations' section. Also will add a short prompt-set example for our evals page.

Rahul: Pricing note: recommend GA with simple flat per-token rates and pilot enterprise discounts (volume/commit later). No complex tiered discounts at GA — keeps billing simpler. Need FinOps to sign off on numbers.

Leah: Support side: plan for 24/5 coverage at GA with an oncall rotation. Escalation path to Eng-SRE for infra incidents. We should publish a one-pager for customers: "how to open a priority ticket" + expected SLAs for responses.

Ben: Monitoring specifics (short): per-route p50/p95 latency, request token cost, 5xx rate, cache hit rate, KV cache eviction counter. Also synthetic smoke tests run on deploy. Example alerts: `rate(5xx) > 0.5%` OR `p95_latency > 400ms` for >5m.

Sofia: Scope decision: we need to cut custom quantization workflows from GA. Focus on model variants, routing policies, and clear documentation. Everyone OK with that?

Maya: Ack — docs will flag custom quantization as "coming soon" and include a migration checklist for teams that rely on quantized artifacts.

Rahul: Action: I'll draft the pricing table by EOD Friday. Need average tokens/request assumptions from eng. @Maya can you surface typical sample sizes?

Ben: @Maya can you also add a sample Grafana dashboard (latency, token-cost, cache-hit) so I can wire alerts into Alertmanager? I'll add alert playbooks once we have the metrics pinned.

Leah: I'll draft the enterprise-facing SLA pass-through and coordinate with commercial to ensure requests map to our support tiers. Also propose a 2-week warm-response policy post-GA for priority customers.

release-bot: deploy scheduled — canary rollout tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Reminder: run smoke tests and validate token-cost telemetry.

Sofia: Owners recap: SLAs/monitoring — Ben; Docs — Maya; Pricing — Rahul + FinOps; Support handoff — Leah; Rollout ops — eng-infra/release-bot. Any objections?

Ben: :thumbsup: I'll start a runbook template. Quick question — do we want a dedicated incident responder for week-of-GA for faster triage?

Leah: Yes, recommend 1 dedicated responder for the initial 2-week warm period. I'll schedule and add to the runbook.

Maya: Putting a docs PR together now — will include example code, quickstart, and a short migration checklist plus known limitations.

Sofia: Final ask before we close: add a 5-item checklist to the PRs: SLA table link, runbook link, support contact + escalation doc, pricing table link, and smoke-test dashboard link. If those are green by Friday we can cut.

Rahul: Noted. I'll ping FinOps and link the draft pricing doc here when ready.

Ben: I'll open the runbook PR after initial template. Will include ``/runbook ga-first-14-days`` sections.

Leah: I'll add the support playbook and a short customer-facing doc called "Priority support — how it works".

Sofia: Thanks all — will follow up with a short owners email summarizing next steps.
